slots.name: altitude drop
slots.sentence: Nearly two and a half hours out of Dubai, passengers on Flight 1073 felt the plane plunge more than 14,000 feet in less than 30 seconds – shaking the cabin as it dropped over Saudi Arabia.

slots.name: passenger count
slots.sentence: Inside the cockpit on Sept. 30, Flydubai airlines pilot Smit Machchhar had just been stabbed by his fellow co-pilot in an apparent effort to crash the plane carrying 170 passengers, including four with U.S. citizenship, to Tel Aviv.

slots.name: landing delay
slots.sentence: Then another saving grace: A second flight crew, riding on board, was able to land the plane 83 minutes after it first started dropping.

slots.name: pilot condition

slots.name: flight suspension

slots.name: co-pilot arrest
